t: This is the place of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion 2000, a structure that is recorded as destroyed, so there may be little or nothing to see of it now. It was designed by Zaha Hadid, the Iraqi British architect, who was born in Baghdad and studied mathematics before turning to architecture at the Architectural Association in 1972. She used painting as a design tool, and is recognised as a key figure in the architecture of the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries.
